name: naaticcl-ccl-practice
description: Practise NAATI CCL interpreting dialogues segment by segment, with exam-speed audio, point-by-point marking of your interpretation, model answers and NAATI test dates. By naaticcl.com, an independent practice site.

interface.longDescription:
Practise for the NAATI Credentialed Community Language (CCL) test, the interpreting test many people in Australia take for migration points.

Ask for a dialogue in your language and topic (Health, Legal, Housing, Immigration, Employment and more). Each dialogue has 12 segments with exam-speed audio. A card plays one segment at a time with the text hidden, as in the test; you type or dictate your interpretation in the chat, and it is marked point by point: which pieces of information you kept, changed or left out, and the share of information kept. Where one is ready, you also see a model answer and the points an examiner checks. You can also ask when the next CCL session for your language is listed by NAATI.

Who it is for: people preparing for the CCL test in any of 50+ languages, and teachers practising with their students.

Limitations: marking is an estimate by naaticcl.com's AI marker, not a NAATI score. Each person can have 3 interpretations marked per day in ChatGPT. Interpretations are typed or dictated as text; the app does not record audio. Test dates come from NAATI's public test date search, checked every 2 hours; NAATI updates its list about once a day, so confirm in myNAATI. The dialogues are original practice material written for naaticcl.com, not NAATI test content.

naaticcl.com is run by PTE Study Pty Ltd (Australia) and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NAATI.
capabilities: Find NAATI CCL practice dialogues by language and topic
Play exam-speed audio, one segment at a time
Mark an interpretation point by point
Show model answers and the points an examiner checks
Check NAATI's listed CCL test dates
defaultPrompt: Give me a Hindi NAATI CCL practice dialogue about health
Practise a Mandarin CCL dialogue with me and mark my interpretation
Quiz me on a Nepali CCL legal dialogue, one segment at a time

positive.description: Find practice dialogues by language and topic
positive.prompt: Find me Punjabi NAATI CCL practice dialogues about housing
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 10 Punjabi dialogues on Housing with their titles, ids and links to naaticcl.com, and offers to start one with segment 1.

positive.description: Play one segment the way the test presents it
positive.prompt: Start the Hindi practice dialogue fhi_acute_infective_conj from segment 1
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card for segment 1 of 12: the nurse speaks English and the student interprets into Hindi. The card has an audio player, the transcript hidden behind Show text, and asks the student to type or dictate their interpretation. ChatGPT does not translate the segment itself.

positive.prompt: Mark my interpretation of segment 1 of dialogue fhi_acute_infective_conj: जल्दी आने के लिए धन्यवाद। मेरे पास आपकी फ़ाइल है, आपकी आँख लाल है। क्या हो रहा है?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a marking card: each piece of information marked kept, changed or left out (here the nurse's name is left out), the share of information kept labelled as an AI estimate and not a NAATI score, the model answer, the points an examiner checks, markings left today, and a Next segment button.

positive.prompt: Which languages can I practise for the NAATI CCL test here?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 50+ languages with the number of practice dialogues in each and how many have model answers, with a link to naaticcl.com.

positive.description: Check the next test dates for a language
positive.prompt: When is the next NAATI CCL test for Nepali?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the next Nepali CCL sessions with seats as listed in NAATI's public test date search, when it was checked, the note that naaticcl.com checks every 2 hours and NAATI updates about once a day, a reminder to confirm in myNAATI, and a link to the Nepali test dates page.

negative.description: General translation is not CCL practice
negative.prompt: Translate this email into French for me: Thanks for the meeting today, see you next week.

negative.description: The app cannot book or pay for a NAATI test
negative.prompt: Book me a NAATI CCL test for next Tuesday and pay the fee

negative.description: No recalled or leaked exam content
negative.prompt: Give me the real dialogues from last week's NAATI CCL Hindi exam

review.commerce_description: The app sells nothing and has no checkout. Results link to the related page on naaticcl.com.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: privacy policy rewritten after review. It now states, for the current tools, the inputs and outputs of each tool, the data handled, purposes, recipients, retention periods and user controls: https://naaticcl.com/legal-en#chatgpt. Tool names, parameters and annotations are unchanged. Five tools: list_languages, find_dialogues, get_segment (card with audio player, transcript hidden), mark_interpretation (card with point-by-point marking and model answer; 3 per user per day) and test_dates.
